name: Muhammad Mateen
about:
For the past **8+ years**, **Mateen** has been building the future of mobile through **Flutter** and **Hybrid** technologies. He is a specialist in **end-to-end implementation**—bridging the gap between **front-end aesthetics** and **back-end logic** with **NodeJS**, all while ensuring flawless delivery through **CI/CD excellence**.

Beyond the codebase, he brings the same dedication to his personal passions:

🎮 **Gaming**: He enjoys jumping into a good game on his PS5 to unwind.
👨‍👩‍👦 **Family**: He’s a proud father who stays busy with the day-to-day joys of raising a kid.
🍳 **Cooking**: He likes getting into the kitchen and trying out new recipes.
🛣️ **Driving**: He loves hitting the road for a long drive to clear his head.

He is currently looking for his **next challenge** where he can apply his **project management expertise** and **technical vision** to build products that users love.
